executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion or removes a named completion blocker.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, or advances a macrocycle.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A human or infrastructure gate blocks only the sensitive action; other enabled projects continue.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch one closure work item per enabled project unless waiting solely on an external human gate.

closureWorkItem.objective: Verify and integrate authenticated durable result write/reopen tied to exact plan and session version.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: UI polish, refactors or unrelated workout features

exitCriteria.description: Workout result is stored durably and linked to the authenticated user and exact plan/session version.
History can be reopened after restart and displays completed, partial and safely stopped sessions.
Progression consumes persisted results rather than browser-local or query-only state.
Product CI, independent Robot QA and realistic end-to-end flow pass on the exact integrated SHA.

active.title: Database operativo, persistenza e audit foundation

closureWorkItem.objective: Run exact-SHA delta Robot R01-R03 and cumulative corpus, then require independent review before integration.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: Further SQLite hardening or generic expansion not required by a failing closure gate

exitCriteria.description: Canonical schema exists for products, stock movements, users and audit events.
A reversible isolated migration creates the development database without production mutation.
A real operator journey writes and reloads persistent state transactionally.
Every mutation produces an attributable immutable audit event.
Backup, rollback and recovery are tested in isolation.
Delta Robot QA, cumulative Robot simulation and post-merge replay pass on exact SHA.

closureWorkItem.objective: Verify and integrate bounded authenticated upload with durable metadata/object persistence, idempotency and rollback.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: Gallery polish, local-only flows or unrelated media features

exitCriteria.description: An authenticated user can upload a bounded real photo into an isolated development environment.
Media metadata and object reference persist across restart and a new authenticated session.
Upload is idempotent and rejects malformed, oversized or unsupported content fail closed.
Delete and rollback preserve consistency between metadata and object storage.
Product CI, independent Robot QA and a realistic upload-reopen journey pass on exact integrated SHA.

transitionRule: Activate the next macrocycle only after every exit criterion is VERIFIED and a completion receipt is persisted.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration and completion fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry.
